import arena,subprocess,time,chess
for turn in range(40):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 p=subprocess.run(['./player',b.fen(),'20'],capture_output=True,text=True)
 print(p.stdout,flush=True)
 m=p.stdout.split('bestmove ')[-1].split()[0]
 if chess.Move.from_uci(m) not in b.legal_moves:
  print('ILLEGAL',m,flush=True);break
 arena.cmd_move(m)
 print('',flush=True)
